conviction_note: This is a non-result. GLDG is an exploration holding company. Its P&L is exploration spend plus below-the-line tax and derivative noise, and its main equity stakes (Gold Royalty, NevGold, Australian Mines) are marked through OCI. The last three interim filings moved the stock +1.2%, +0.8% and 0.0% the next session. The filing date itself is unconfirmed. The findings sum to -0.2 and the scaled number is (2*0.49-1)*2.0 = -0.04. Both are effectively zero, and they agree.
bar: Effectively none. findings.finding: Q3 FY26 (Jun-Aug 2026) will most likely show a net loss of several million C$, against a reported near-breakeven Q3 FY25 (net loss C$0.1m, C$0.4m attributable income). Last year's quarter was propped up by a C$7.1m deferred tax recovery from remeasuring the Gold Royalty shares. This quarter GROY was roughly flat (US$3.25 on 2026-05-29 to US$3.32 on 2026-08-31), so no comparable recovery is likely, and the headline will read as a swing to loss year on year against an operating loss run-rate of about C$7-8m a quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY25 printed a profit swing and the stock moved +1.2% the next session (1.71 on 2025-10-10 to 1.73 on 2025-10-13, Yahoo daily closes). Q1 FY26 moved +0.8% (2026-04-10) and H1 FY26, a C$8.8m quarterly loss, moved 0.0% (2026-07-14). The net-income line has never moved this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody models the deferred tax line for an exploration holdco, so a YoY swing to loss would be new as a headline. It is also irrelevant to value. If the market cared, the prior three filings would not have moved the stock by 0-1.2%.
findings.independence: The H1 FY26 MD&A shows the deferred tax line swung to a C$2.8m expense and the quarterly loss ran at C$8.8m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001538847/000143774926023556/ex_985515.htm). GROY prices come from the Yahoo chart. These are different documents from the source, but all of it is inference about a statement nobody has seen yet.

findings.finding: Funding: at 2026-05-31 group cash was C$21.4m, of which C$8.2m sits in U.S. GoldMining and is not available to the parent. The parent funds exploration through a US$50m ATM that expires on 2026-12-08; it raised C$10.1m in H1 (4.77M shares) but only C$0.8m in Q2. The Q3 MD&A will show how much stock was sold at about US$1 or less and may flag a replacement shelf or ATM. Asking what the money buys: the 2026 Yarumalito drilling (completed 'on schedule and within budget' per the 2026-10-06 release) and São Jorge/La Mina follow-up after three PEAs, with no going-concern language and US$70m of liquid GROY shares behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY26 disclosed C$10.1m of ATM issuance and the stock was unchanged the next session (0.85 to 0.85, 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-15).
findings.why_not_priced: The quarter's issuance count and any new shelf are not public until the filing. If the market expected heavy dilution at these prices, the stock would trade at a wider discount to its stakes. Market cap is about US$190m against roughly US$60m USGO + US$70m GROY + ~US$40m NevGold + cash, which already points to a holdco discount.
findings.independence: The Q3 FY25 MD&A shows the parent ran on C$6.5m of cash at 2025-08-31 and kept funding through the ATM, so low cash is normal for this company and not distress (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1538847/000143774925030866/ex_866937.htm).

findings.finding: Holdings marked at quarter end: USGO (about 74% owned, 10.0M shares, consolidated) fell from US$10.20 to US$8.95 over the quarter and has since dropped to US$6.03 (2026-10-08). GROY (21.5M shares) was flat at about US$3.3, now US$3.03-3.09. The MD&A will restate the stake values at the Aug-31 marks plus the subsequent-events section. The USGO slide also produces a P&L gain on USGO warrant derivative liabilities (+C$1.9m in Q2 on a smaller move).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None separable: the stake values are published every quarter in the MD&A, and the next-session moves were 0 to +1.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. Both stakes are listed and quoted daily, and GLDG's -14% over 20 days already tracks the USGO slide. It is filed so the judges can see the main value driver is outside the print.
findings.independence: The GROY price series (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GROY?range=6mo&interval=1d) and the H1 MD&A stake table come from different sources but describe the same public marks.

lessons_applied: Rule 2 (one-offs): the YoY swing-to-loss rests on a deferred tax line below operating income with no path to value, so it moved from -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the ATM funds visible exploration (Yarumalito completed on budget, three PEAs), with no going-concern flag and liquid GROY behind it, so it moved from -0.3 to -0.1.
Pessimism artefact plus the reaction function (rule 1): p_up moved from 48 to 49 because the line has never moved the stock.
Untrustworthy history: the base rate was rebuilt from confirmed interim filings (0 to 1.2%), which leaves abs_move at 2.0, the 37% annualised daily vol.
